contexts.text: I, or for what am I () = that if they combated on this account they would not receive influx from rational truth; hence straitness.
Behold, I am with thee () = what is Divine... (For) the I, here, is Jehovah, thus what is Divine of the Lord.
I am Pharaoh () = that thence is the Natural.
I fear God () = from the Divine; for by Joseph is represented the Lord as to truth from the Divine... and therefore by I, here, in the supreme sense, is signified truth from the Divine.
I am Jehovah () = confirmation by the Divine.
That ye may know that I am Jehovah () = that it may be known to them that the Lord is the only God.
land none besides me () = the falsity of Own intelligence.
